decomposition.naming_docs_index_option (binary -> 3way: +0.125, recovers items 3 and 4 (large references the binary framing pushes into 'skill')

notes: Zero within-condition variance at n=5: every run in a condition produced identical labels. The misroutes are systematic failure modes, not noise — the skill removes deterministic errors, not just variance.

baseline_binary's binary-axis accuracy is also 0.75 (not higher): faced with a large reference and no docs-index option, the model chose 'skill' rather than 'agents', so it is wrong on the coarse call too — the harm of the binary framing is real, not merely notational.
